result.title: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
result.summary: We study the conditional distribution of limit-order volume submitted over the next five minutes, given the current order book and recent order flow. The task requires capturing price placement, total volume, and predictive uncertainty jointly. Coordinate-wise diffusion losses do not explicitly account for price displacement, while normalizing fields to unit mass removes information about total volume. Agreement on selected summary statistics also does not establish fidelity to the joint field distribution. We introduce OrderFlowDiT, a conditional Diffusion Transformer for unnormalized bid and ask volume-at-price fields, trained with an unbalanced optimal-transport (UOT) auxiliary loss. We also develop a full-field evaluation framework that combines a transport cost sensitive to price placement and total volume with proper scoring rules and calibration diagnostics. In the primary comparison on 1950 validation conditions across 30 U.S. equities, adding UOT reduces full-field transport cost by 45.8% and the transport energy score by 26.1% relative to training with mean squared error alone. Both measures improve for every stock. These findings support incorporating price geometry and volume into generative modeling, with field accuracy and predictive uncertainty evaluated together.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 OrderFlowDiT，用条件 Diffusion Transformer 对未归一化的买卖量-价格场联合建模，并加入非平衡最优传输（UOT）辅助损失；同时构建结合传输代价、proper scoring rule 与校准诊断的整场评价框架，在 30 只美股、1950 个验证条件下测试。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于金融订单流预测，与 LVR 主线无直接关系；但其以 UOT 辅助损失对连续空间场施加几何敏感监督、并用传输代价与校准诊断联合评价生成分布的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉几何保真的 latent 监督与分布评价设计。
